timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1,547.3 KRW/USD (as of 2026-06-26 open)

WHY: The won is at a 17-year weakness high, meaning you need significantly more KRW to buy your $2,000. However, news indicates this peak is temporary—a $30 billion SK Hynix dollar inflow arriving in July is expected to strengthen the won and push rates down to the 1,400s, suggesting better timing is coming soon.

TIP: If possible, defer or reduce this month's conversion and wait for July when the SK Hynix capital influx should weaken the dollar-to-won rate, saving you thousands of won.
